description: Snap-on is a leading global innovator, manufacturer and marketer of tools, equipment, diagnostics, repair information and systems solutions for professional users performing critical tasks including those working in vehicle repair, aerospace, the military, natural resources and manufacturing, and from its founding in 1920 Snap-on has been recognized as the mark of the serious and the outward sign of the pride and dignity working men and women take in their professions. Its products and services are sold through the company's network of widely recognized franchisee vans as well as through direct and distributor channels under a variety of notable brands, and the company also provides financing programs to facilitate the sales of its products and to support its franchise business, marketing its products and brands worldwide in more than 130 countries with its largest geographic market being the United States, and it offers a broad line of products and complementary services grouped into three product categories: tools, diagnostics, information and management systems, and equipment.
